title: Photography - Electronic Flash Equipment - Connectors to Synchro-Cord
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 15047) covers Photography - Electronic Flash Equipment - Connectors to Synchro-Cord. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 8581:1994 Photography — Electronic flash equipment — Connectors to synchro-cord' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the the Photographic Equipment Sectional Committee and approval of the Mechanical Engineering Division Council. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. In the adopted standard, certain conventions are not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is especially drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker, while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a full point (.) as the decimal marker.
